name: GraphWalks
intro: GraphWalks 是 OpenAI 发布的长上下文图推理数据集，没有配套的构建论文。模型读取哈希节点有向边表，完成精确深度 BFS 或父节点集合查询，并按官方最后一行答案格式返回节点集合。
build_method: 有向图题面与BFS/Parents标签生成；官方未公开图采样算法
task_type: 图推理, 长上下文集合预测
eval_feature: 精确深度BFS, 父节点查询, 集合F1, 最后一行答案解析
build_method_en: Directed Graph Prompt and BFS/Parents Label Generation; Graph Sampling Algorithm Not Documented
eval_feature_en: Exact-depth BFS, Parent Query, Set F1, Last-line Answer Parser
intro_en: GraphWalks is an OpenAI long-context graph-reasoning dataset without a companion construction paper. Models read a directed edge list with hashed node names, execute exact-depth BFS or parent-set queries, and return a node set in the official last-line answer format.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official openai/graphwalks dataset card, schema, files, extraction code, grading code, and changelog; no construction paper is published, so the graph sampling algorithm is explicitly left undocumented rather than inferred. The current dataset has 1,150 rows in one train split: 550 BFS and 600 parents items, with prompt, answer_nodes, prompt_chars, problem_type, and date_added fields. Prompts serialize directed edge lists with hashed node identifiers and fixed worked examples. BFS labels include nodes reachable at exactly the requested depth while excluding the start and revisited nodes; parents labels are incoming neighbors excluding the target. The 2026 repair corrected 24 of 400 short-set parent labels that had included the root. Models must put Final Answer: [...] on the last line; malformed output becomes an empty prediction. Official grading compares node sets with precision, recall, and F1, including F1=1 for empty/empty.
